'''Thoradin''' was the leader of the [[Arathi tribe]] of humans. He led them to unify the various human tribes into the great nation of [[Empire of Arathor|Arathor]], founded the capital of [[Strom]], and forged an alliance with the high elves in the [[Troll Wars]].<ref>[[Arathor and the Troll Wars]]</ref> After many peaceful years of growth and commerce, mighty Thoradin died of old age, leaving Arathor's younger generation free to expand the empire beyond the lands of Strom.<ref>[[The Guardians of Tirisfal]]</ref>

A huge [[Thoradin's Wall|wall]] between [[Arathi Highlands]] and [[Hillsbrad Foothills|Hillsbrad]] has been either named in his memory or built by himself or one of his descendants bearing same name.
